assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: incapable
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

The scenario needs the session to stay working past its turn's own end while a backgrounded shell process lives. Agent side: OpenCode 2.x can move a running shell tool into background observation (POST /api/session/{id}/background, 2.1.4 openapi.json). Daemon side, read from code: BackgroundProcessCount is set only by the shared tailer (tailer_metrics.go) and the muse/geminicli parsers; the opencode fold (metrics.go, metrics_v2.go) bypasses the tailer and never sets it, so nothing holds a 2.x session working after its turn ends.

## Probe (2026-11-08 11:06, not promoted; evidence in /Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b1-work/probe-3-3/)

- Agent side confirmed: POST /background moved the running `sleep 25` into background (a `synthetic` row, 'User requested that active blocking work be moved to the background'), and the turn ended (idle succeeded, Stop hook 11:06:51.770) while the process ran.
- Daemon side confirmed: the session went ready at that Stop hook — not held for the live process. When the process finished the service injected a `synthetic` `<shell … state="completed">` row and ran one more turn; the daemon showed it only as instant ready → working → ready blips (11:07:15.146/.147, and the Stop at 16.427/.429).
- A daemon finding beside the freeze: right after the hook-ended ready at 11:06:51.770 the session bounced ready → working → ready twice (+18ms, +440ms), and the P5-0 tail skip (#2120) did not fire for that turn — it did for the follow-up turn (11:07:16.865). Not root-caused here; read as unverified hypotheses: the backgrounded tool still `running` in the stored step at that moment (IsAgentDone false), or the 2.x parser's missing branch for `synthetic` rows (parseV2Message returns false for them).

## Spec choices

The scenario's: the session's ready comes well after the turn's own Stop hook (held while the process lives).
caveats: Frozen: daemon incapable, by code (the opencode fold never sets BackgroundProcessCount) and by the probe (ready at the turn's own Stop hook while the process lived). The probe recording was not promoted: its spec fails by design, and it carries the bounce finding above.
The probe's session is ses_e456033afffetBAtO93x62DTkz in the sandbox store.

sources.note: queryV2SessionMetrics re-folds every session_message row in seq order; cumulative tokens/cost come from the session_v2 columns
BackgroundProcessCount is set by the tailer; the opencode fold never runs it

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
send a prompt that runs `sleep 25`; once the shell tool runs, background it; wait for the turn end; 30s

script.text: Run the shell command `sleep 25` with the shell tool, then reply with exactly the word: started.

verify: the turn ends while the backgrounded shell process still runs
the session stays working until the process exits
